svg.title: How the Rust workflows fit together
svg.desc: A consumer repository calls the reusable Rust CI on every commit or pull request. Publishing runs that same CI with one job in front of it: a preflight job authorises the boundary before any build, the same revision runs CI, a staging job re-verifies the exact artifact, and the publishing job runs only once the dry run is turned off. From the same run, opt-in jobs upload the SARIF findings to code scanning and the coverage and test results to Codecov, and test the project on macOS, Windows and Linux arm64. Signing and evidence upload are opt-in workflows because they hold elevated scopes. There is no route into publication that skips CI.
